name: Filling Honeycomb
text: When you play this card, create a copy of it in your hand.
archetypes: Spade Master, Discard Dominance, Diamond Flood; splash Heart Chorus
decision: When to play this card: a high card early, so its copy wins again later, or a card of your flood suit to lengthen it.
opponent: The copy is shown when created; opponents see a second card of that suit and rank coming.
aiNote: Play this card as soon as it can win a trick, then play the copy when it can win again.
rationale: One extra card of the same suit and rank: on an ace or king it is often a second winner (about +half a trick), and on a flood suit it is one more diamond or heart for its payoffs. The copy carries no sigil, so it never repeats itself.
deviation: Totally redesigned from a run-long counter of off-suit plays, which was far too complicated.
